policy.fetch_method: git init; git remote add origin <url>; git fetch --depth 1 origin <revision>; git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
policy.checkout_location: upstreams/<name> (gitignored; clones and their working trees stay local, only this manifest tracks the pins)
policy.verified_with: git rev-parse HEAD after checkout; license files read from the checkout

upstreams.name: reap
upstreams.role: REAP observation and pruning plumbing; extension seam for HOPE (per contract: extend observation/plumbing, no independent pruning framework)

upstreams.name: strix-llama.cpp
upstreams.role: Strix Halo (gfx1151) runtime target: ROCm/HIP and Vulkan backends, MiMo (LLM_ARCH_MIMO2) architecture support with MTP and SWA

patches.note: platform compile fix: llama-ple-disk prefetch advice — Darwin fcntl(F_RDADVISE), Linux posix_fadvise unchanged; no IO or behavior change on Linux/gfx1151

NVMe/SWA continuation fix: SLOT_RESTORE rebuilds slot.prompt.checkpoints with a prefix-end checkpoint after prompt.clear(), so the next continuation request reuses the restored prefix (n_past = LCP) instead of do_reset full re-prefill; regression seam docs/nvme-continuation.md

MiMo native MXFP4 converter: pairs packed expert payloads with E8M0 scales, losslessly emits GGML MXFP4 MoE, fixes the early expert-merge KeyError, and explicitly refuses second_gen_affine GGUF conversion (use the exact layer-streamed scorer)

Source-correct tokenizer NFC support with tokenizer.ggml.normalizer.nfc metadata and ICU4C Unicode normalization; malformed UTF-8 uses HF-compatible U+FFFD semantics, ICU uc is explicitly required with no fallback. Bounded Mac tests are recorded in manifests/hardware/readiness.json; static installed-consumer link and non-BPE gate remain pending; no Halo or universal tokenizer claim.

upstreams.name: rocmfp4
upstreams.role: ROCmFP4 quantization format: Q4_0_ROCMFP4 (4.50 bpw, dual UE4M3 scales per 32 weights) and Q4_0_ROCMFP4_FAST (4.25 bpw, single scale); patch/build/regression scripts

upstreams.name: llama.cpp
